capture.title: Region capture
capture.description: How the screen looks while you pick an area.

detectWindows.label: Detect windows
detectWindows.description: Highlight the window under the mouse so one click captures it.

detectControls.label: Detect controls
detectControls.description: Also highlight buttons, panels and other parts inside windows.

showMagnifier.label: Magnifier
showMagnifier.description: Show a zoomed view next to the mouse for pixel exact selections.

playSound.label: Shutter sound
playSound.description: Play a camera shutter sound when a screenshot is taken.

afterCapture.title: After capture
afterCapture.description: What happens to a screenshot once it is taken.

upload.label: Upload to Fileship
upload.description: Upload the screenshot with your upload settings.

annotate.label: Open the editor
annotate.description: Draw, blur and add text before the next steps. Region captures are edited while you select.

copyImage.label: Copy image
copyImage.description: Put the image itself on the clipboard.

saveToFile.label: Save to this computer
saveToFile.description: Keep a copy in the folder from the upload settings.

afterUpload.title: After upload
afterUpload.description: What happens once a file is on Fileship.

copyUrl.label: Copy link
copyUrl.description: Put the link on the clipboard.

shortenUrl.label: Shorten link
shortenUrl.description: Create a short link and use it instead.

openUrl.label: Open link
openUrl.description: Open the link in your browser.

notify.label: Show a notification
notify.description: Click the notification to open the link.

playSound.label: Upload sound
playSound.description: Play a short chime when an upload finishes.
